# General settings
```{r}
denoise <- T
denoise.vars.to.regress <- c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")

filter <- F
if (filter) {
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)
}

downsample <- F

# DEG settings
cell.type.of.interest <- "OPC"
test.use <- "MAST" 
min.pct.use <- 0.1
logfc.threshold.use <- 0.25


markers.dir <- paste0(figures.dir, "markers/", cell.type.of.interest, "/")
dir.create(paste0(figures.dir, "markers/"))
dir.create(markers.dir)
```



# Prepare data for DEG analysis
```{r}
seurat.obj$cell.id <- colnames(seurat.obj)
predictions.df <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Classifier/", "output/", "my_data_predictions.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, predictions.df)

if (cell.type.of.interest == "Neurons") {
  seurat.obj$celltype.final <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(as.logical(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]]), row[["labels_initial"]], row[["predicted.annotation_l1"]])) 
} else {
  seurat.obj$celltype.final <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(as.logical(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]]), row[["labels_initial"]], row[["predicted.annotation_l2"]])) 
}



if (cell.type.of.interest == "Myeloid") {
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (celltype.final == cell.type.of.interest) | (celltype.final == "Immune" & predicted.annotation_l2 == cell.type.of.interest))
} else if (cell.type.of.interest %in% c("Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes")) {
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (celltype.final == cell.type.of.interest) | (celltype.final == "Glial" & predicted.annotation_l2 == cell.type.of.interest))
} else if (cell.type.of.interest %in% c("Neurons")) {
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (celltype.final == cell.type.of.interest) | (celltype.final == "Neurons" & predicted.annotation_l1 == cell.type.of.interest))
} else if (cell.type.of.interest == "OPC") {
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = predicted.annotation_l2 == cell.type.of.interest)
}



Idents(seurat.obj.subset) <- "sample.desc.method"

if (downsample) {
  seurat.obj.subset$downsample <- T
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = 100)
}


#seurat.obj.subset <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.subset, gene.signatures[c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")]) 

print(dim(seurat.obj.subset))

# only use samples with >= 10 cells for that cell type
samples.min.cells <- table(seurat.obj.subset$sample.desc.method) %>% data.frame() %>% filter(Freq >= 10) %>% pull(Var1)
non.distal.samples <- seurat.obj.subset@meta.data %>% filter(location != "Distal") %>% pull(sample.desc.method) %>% unique()
samples.use <- intersect(samples.min.cells, non.distal.samples)

print(samples.use)
```



# DEGs: Tumor-adjacent vs distal for cell type of interest (i.e. oligodendrocytes)
```{r}
all.markers.df <- data.frame()

for (sample.i in samples.use) {
  
  if (grepl("GBM 1", sample.i)) { 
    patient <- "GBM 1"
  } else if (grepl("GBM 2", sample.i)) { 
    patient <- "GBM 2"
  } else if (grepl("IDH-mut 1", sample.i)) { 
    patient <- "IDH-mut 1"
  }
  control.sample <- paste(patient, "Distal")
  
  if (grepl("FACS", sample.i)) {
    method <- "FACS"
  } else if (grepl("10X", sample.i)) { 
    method <- "10X"
  } else if (grepl("Invent", sample.i)) {
    method <- "Invent"
  } else {
    stop(paste0("Unknown method ", sample.i))
  }
  control.sample <- paste(control.sample, method)
  
  
  print("sample.i:")
  print(sample.i)
  
  print("control.sample:")
  print(control.sample)
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(seurat.obj.subset, ident.1 = sample.i, ident.2 = control.sample, 
                         min.pct = min.pct.use, logfc.threshold = logfc.threshold.use, test.use=test.use,
                         latent.vars = denoise.vars.to.regress)
  markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
  markers$sample <- sample.i
  markers$control.sample <- control.sample
  markers$patient <- patient
  markers$method <- method
  all.markers.df <- rbind(all.markers.df, markers)
}

write.table(all.markers.df, paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=", denoise, ".tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
```



# DEGs: Cell type of interest (i.e. oligodendrocytes) vs malignant DEGs in tumor samples
```{r}

if (cell.type.of.interest == "Neurons") {
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "predicted.annotation_l1"
} else {
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "predicted.annotation_l2"
}


markers.df <- data.frame()
for (tumor.sample in samples.use) {
  print(tumor.sample)
  
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.desc.method == tumor.sample)
  
  if (grepl("GBM 1", tumor.sample)) { 
    patient <- "GBM 1"
  } else if (grepl("GBM 2", tumor.sample)) { 
    patient <- "GBM 2"
  } else if (grepl("IDH-mut 1", tumor.sample)) { 
    patient <- "IDH-mut 1"
  }
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(seurat.obj.subset, ident.1 = cell.type.of.interest, ident.2 = "Malignant cluster", 
                         min.pct = min.pct.use, logfc.threshold = logfc.threshold.use, test.use = test.use, 
                         latent.vars = c(denoise.vars.to.regress))
  markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
  markers$patient <- patient
  markers$sample <- tumor.sample
  
  markers.df <- rbind(markers.df, markers)
}

write.table(markers.df, paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_", cell.type.of.interest, "_vs_malignant_denoise=", denoise, ".tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
```



# Consensus DEGs
```{r}
markers.dir <- paste0(figures.dir, "markers/", cell.type.of.interest, "/")
samples.use <- c("GBM 1 Core FACS", "GBM 1 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Core FACS", "GBM 2 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Brainstem FACS")


# Tumor adjacent
all.markers.df <- read.csv(paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t")
all.markers.df.filter <- all.markers.df %>% filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25, p_val_adj < 0.05, sample %in% samples.use)
summary.df <- all.markers.df.filter %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarize(n.samples = n_distinct(sample), 
  n.patients = n_distinct(patient),
  median.avg_log2FC = median(avg_log2FC),
  median.p_val_adj = median(p_val_adj),
  samples.up = paste0(sort(sample), collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n.samples))

write.table(summary.df, paste0(markers.dir, "summary_DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)



# Cell type of interest (e.g. Oligodendrocytes) vs tumor
all.markers.df <- read.csv(paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_", cell.type.of.interest, "_vs_malignant_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t")
all.markers.df.filter <- all.markers.df %>% filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25, p_val_adj < 0.05, sample %in% samples.use)
summary.df <- all.markers.df.filter %>% 
  group_by(gene) %>% 
  summarize(n.samples = n_distinct(sample), 
  n.patients = n_distinct(patient),
  median.avg_log2FC = median(avg_log2FC),
  median.p_val_adj = median(p_val_adj),
  samples.up = paste0(sort(sample), collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n.samples))

write.table(summary.df, paste0(markers.dir, "summary_DEGs_matched_", cell.type.of.interest, "_vs_malignant_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
stop()


summary.df <- read.csv(paste0(markers.dir, "summary_DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t")
summary.df %>% dplyr::filter(median.avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% head(100) %>% pull(gene)
```

# Volcano plots and GSEA
Start here after DEG analysis
```{r}
tumor.samples.use <- c("GBM 1 Core FACS", "GBM 1 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Core FACS", "GBM 2 Edge FACS", "GBM 2 Brainstem FACS")

## Volcano plot of DEGs
markers.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Figures/Figure 4/markers/Oligodendrocytes/")
all.markers.df <- read.csv(paste0(markers.dir, "DEGs_matched_sample_vs_distal_denoise=TRUE.tsv"), sep = "\t")

all.markers.df.filter <- all.markers.df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, sample %in% tumor.samples.use) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarize(n.samples = n_distinct(sample), 
            n.patients = n_distinct(patient),
            median.avg_log2FC = median(avg_log2FC),
            median.p_val_adj = median(p_val_adj),
            samples.up = paste0(sample, collapse = ", ")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n.samples))
summary.df <- all.markers.df.filter


summary.df.filter <- summary.df %>% filter(n.samples >= 4) 
# genes.up.label <- unique(c(summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC > 0) %>% arrange(median.p_val_adj) %>% head(10) %>% pull(gene), 
#                            summary.df.filter %>% arrange(desc(median.avg_log2FC)) %>% head(10) %>% pull(gene)))
# genes.down.label <- unique(c(summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC < 0) %>% arrange(median.p_val_adj) %>% head(10) %>% pull(gene), 
#                            summary.df.filter %>% arrange(median.avg_log2FC) %>% head(10) %>% pull(gene)))

# Volcano plot

innate.interferon.genes <- c("STAT1", "IFI16", "GBP2") 
proteostasis.stress.genes <- c("ERO1A", "ATF3") # "EIF2AK2", "GARS",
structural.remodeling.genes <- c("ASAP1", "EPS8", "CD44")
trafficking.biosytnehsis.genes <- c("ANXA2", "SQSTM1", "B4GALT5")
myelin.genes <- c("MBP", "PLP1", "MOG", "ASPA")
other.genes.of.interest <- c("HIF1A", "VEGFA", "VIM", "APOE")

cholesterol.genes <- c("APOE", "APOA1", "APOA2", "CLU", "APOD", "LRP1", "LDLR", "SORL1")


summary.df$gene.category <- sapply(summary.df$gene, function(x) case_when(
  x %in% innate.interferon.genes ~ "Innate Immune & Interferon",
  x %in% proteostasis.stress.genes ~ "Proteostasis & Metabolic Stress",
  x %in% structural.remodeling.genes ~ "Structural & Signaling Remodeling",
  x %in% trafficking.biosytnehsis.genes ~ "Trafficking & Biosynthesis",
  x %in% myelin.genes ~ "Myelin",
  x %in% other.genes.of.interest ~ "Hypoxia & TME",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
))


# summary.df$gene.category <- sapply(summary.df$gene, function(x) case_when(
#   x %in% cholesterol.genes ~ "Cholesterol",
#   TRUE ~ "Other"
# ))
summary.df$gene.label <- apply(summary.df, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["gene.category"]] != "Other", row[["gene"]], ""))

gene.category.colors <- c(
  "Innate Immune & Interferon"        = "#D55E00", 
  "Proteostasis & Metabolic Stress"   = "#0072B2", 
  "Structural & Signaling Remodeling" = "#CC79A7", 
  "Trafficking & Biosynthesis"        = "#009E73",
  "Hypoxia & TME"                     = "#E69F00",
  "Myelin"                            = "#000000", 
  "Other"                             = "#999999",
  "Cholesterol"                       = "#56B4E9"  
)

gene.categories <- names(gene.category.colors)

gene.categories.color.scale <- scale_color_manual(breaks = gene.categories, values = gene.category.colors)
gene.categories.fill.scale <- scale_fill_manual(breaks = gene.categories, values = gene.category.colors)

summary.df$gene.category <- factor(summary.df$gene.category, levels = gene.categories)
summary.df <- summary.df %>% arrange(desc(gene.category), n.samples)

p <- ggplot(summary.df, aes(median.avg_log2FC, -log10(median.p_val_adj), label = gene.label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n.samples, fill = gene.category), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21) +
  ylab("-log10 adjusted p-value") +
  xlab("log2FC tumor-adjacent vs distal") +
  gene.categories.fill.scale +
  gene.categories.color.scale +
  geom_text_repel(aes(color = gene.category), size = 5, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(fill = "Gene category") +
  labs(size = "No. tumor samples") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) 
  
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_volcano_plot.pdf"), width = 12, height = 7)
print(p)
dev.off()

## GO analysis

for (deg.direction in c("up", "down")) {
  
  if (deg.direction == "up") {
    genes <- summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% pull(gene)
  } else {
    genes <- summary.df.filter %>% filter(median.avg_log2FC < -0.5) %>% pull(gene)
  }
  go.enrich <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                      keyType = 'SYMBOL',
                      ont = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  
  go.enrich.df <- data.frame(go.enrich)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% filter(Count >= 5, Count <= 30)
  go.enrich.df <- go.enrich.df %>% arrange(desc(FoldEnrichment))
  
  go.enrich.top.df <- go.enrich.df %>% head(20)
  go.enrich.top.df$Description_short <- str_trunc(go.enrich.top.df$Description, width = 80)
  go.enrich.top.df$Description_short <- factor(go.enrich.top.df$Description_short, levels = rev(go.enrich.top.df$Description_short))
  
  go.enrich.top.df <- go.enrich.top.df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene.category = case_when(
      # 1. Innate Immune & Interferon
      str_detect(Description, "interferon") ~ "Innate Immune & Interferon",
      
      # 2. Proteostasis & Metabolic Stress
      str_detect(Description, "folding|starvation|chaperone") ~ "Proteostasis & Metabolic Stress",
      
      # 3. Structural & Process Remodeling
      str_detect(Description, "actin|Rho|synaptic vesicle") ~ "Structural & Signaling Remodeling",
      
      # 4. Trafficking & Biosynthetic Processes
      str_detect(Description, "vacuole|Golgi|plasma membrane|glycan|glycosphingolipid|endocytosis") ~ "Trafficking & Biosynthesis",
      
      # Default for anything that doesn't fit the above
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

  go.enrich.top.df$gene.category <- factor(
    go.enrich.top.df$gene.category,
    levels = gene.categories
  )
  
  # make sure the order matches the plot
  label_colors <- gene.category.colors[
    go.enrich.top.df$gene.category
  ]
  label_colors <- rev(label_colors) # need to reverse to match text
  
  p <- ggplot(
      go.enrich.top.df,
      aes(
        x = FoldEnrichment,
        y = Description_short,
        size = Count,
        color = qvalue
      )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c(direction = -1) +
    ylab("") +
    xlab("Fold enrichment")
  
  if (deg.direction == "up") {
    p <- p + 
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = label_colors)
      )
  }
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_GO_plot_direction=", deg.direction, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  write.table(go.enrich.top.df, paste0(figures.dir, "oligodendrocytes_tumor_adjacent_vs_distal_GO_plot_direction=", deg.direction, "_table.tsv"), sep = "\t")

}
```
